newsitem.title: USA: Orange County bankruptcy probe announcement due.
newsitem.headline: Orange County bankruptcy probe announcement due.

text.p: Orange County, California's district attorney plans to announce a "major development" on Thursday in its long-running investigation of the county's bankruptcy, a county official said.
The district attorney plans to hold a news conference at 11 a.m. local time to make the announcement, the official said. County prosecutors declined to comment in advance.

An Orange County grand jury has been investigating the roles played by various bond and investment firms, and other finance professionals in the county's bankruptcy crisis. The panel's deliberations have been kept secret.

Orange County shocked Wall Street in December 1994 when it filed for bankruptcy after losing more than $1.6 billion on risky investments made by its once respected treasurer, Robert Citron. The county emerged from bankruptcy a year ago.
